content: #Bitcoin doesn't compete with the dollar, it competes with gold, real estate, & securities as a better store of value. Most enlightened regulators understand this. The biggest beneficiary of the spread of #BTC will be USD. The biggest loser is #Gold. The numbers prove this. || Gold is not working as a monetary inflation hedge. || Equity is working much better as a monetary inflation hedge. The S&P index seems like the best benchmark for cost of capital/hurdle rate and illustrates the rate as which the value of the currency is collapsing against a market basket of scarce assets. || #Bitcoin has outperformed every major asset over the past decade. Since billions don't have the option to purchase equity or real estate, their stark choice is lose their wealth steadily via a collapsing currency, or preserve & grow their wealth via #bitcoin with volatility. || I have been a consistent advocate of owning #bitcoin since it was $9,500 per coin. I am also an advocate of borrowing money at 2.5% interest for 30 years when such financing is available. Over the last 10 years, BTC is up 113% annually, S&P is up 12.7%. Either arbitrage works. || Everyone makes their own investment decisions, and I am not a trader so my views are always with a 10+ year time horizon. If you pay off a 2.5% mortgage you are long USD yielding 2.5% while the currency collapses at 7-20% per year, and you are short equity, property, bitcoin etc. || That is why education & communication are so important to the success of #Bitcoin and the smooth progression of our economy from 20th century mechanical assets to 21 century digital assets. There are many enlightened regulators & others are learning fast. || I am not a trader, so I will defer to your judgement on those matters. My conviction is based on the belief that #Bitcoin is a better system for monetizing property than gold, art, land, homes, buildings, & equity and over the long term the marketplace will recognize this. || Reporting from Texas, @Kr00ney does a great job illustrating how #Bitcoin miners harness financial, political, energy, technology & human capital in order to make the network more secure & spread prosperity wherever they operate. The cyber hornets are audible in the background. || I shared my views today with @emilychangtv on the China's trillion dollar mistake, the impact of the China Exodus on #Bitcoin markets and mining, @MicroStrategy 's Bitcoin strategy and our capital structure, as well as why I am so optimistic about the future of digital property.

content: #Bitcoin doesn't compete with the dollar, it competes with gold, real estate, & securities as a better store of value. Most enlightened regulators understand this. The biggest beneficiary of the spread of #BTC will be USD. The biggest loser is #Gold. The numbers prove this. || Gold is not working as a monetary inflation hedge. || Equity is working much better as a monetary inflation hedge. The S&P index seems like the best benchmark for cost of capital/hurdle rate and illustrates the rate as which the value of the currency is collapsing against a market basket of scarce assets. || #Bitcoin has outperformed every major asset over the past decade. Since billions don't have the option to purchase equity or real estate, their stark choice is lose their wealth steadily via a collapsing currency, or preserve & grow their wealth via #bitcoin with volatility. || I have been a consistent advocate of owning #bitcoin since it was $9,500 per coin. I am also an advocate of borrowing money at 2.5% interest for 30 years when such financing is available. Over the last 10 years, BTC is up 113% annually, S&P is up 12.7%. Either arbitrage works. || Everyone makes their own investment decisions, and I am not a trader so my views are always with a 10+ year time horizon. If you pay off a 2.5% mortgage you are long USD yielding 2.5% while the currency collapses at 7-20% per year, and you are short equity, property, bitcoin etc. || That is why education & communication are so important to the success of #Bitcoin and the smooth progression of our economy from 20th century mechanical assets to 21 century digital assets. There are many enlightened regulators & others are learning fast. || I am not a trader, so I will defer to your judgement on those matters. My conviction is based on the belief that #Bitcoin is a better system for monetizing property than gold, art, land, homes, buildings, & equity and over the long term the marketplace will recognize this. || Reporting from Texas, @Kr00ney does a great job illustrating how #Bitcoin miners harness financial, political, energy, technology & human capital in order to make the network more secure & spread prosperity wherever they operate. The cyber hornets are audible in the background. || I shared my views today with @emilychangtv on the China's trillion dollar mistake, the impact of the China Exodus on #Bitcoin markets and mining, @MicroStrategy 's Bitcoin strategy and our capital structure, as well as why I am so optimistic about the future of digital property.

content: On Jan 3, 2009 #Bitcoin was born, operating without economic value for 504 days until May 22, 2010 ("Pizza Day") when two pizzas traded for 10,000 BTC. Satoshi disappeared Dec 13, 2010 without profiting in any way, completing the ethical launch of the world's first digital money. || "With more clarity in #crypto, you're going to see more of the Tier 1 firms able to provide liquidity, able to provide research, able to help enhance price discovery. That will help the market mature..." - Ken Griffin on #Bitcoin || Citadel CEO Ken Griffin speaks at the Bloomberg Intelligence Market Structure conference in New York with Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua 5/19/22. They talk about the economy, the recent market selloff, crypto regulation, energy, and returning to the office.

content: The innovation of #Bitcoin is the creation of stable matter/energy in cyberspace. Electricity is hashed to provide security/integrity, not to deliver transactions. L2/L3 provide speed. || Transaction costs on the #Bitcoin network are currently 1 basis point of value transferred on the base Layer 1, and negligible on the Layer 2 and Layer 3 networks. Bitcoin transactions are growing continually more efficient due to technology advances and economies of scale. || #Bitcoin miners strengthen and stabilize the power grid.
